view: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph; L marker on image right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration, minimal rotation, but low lung volumes with poor inspiratory effort (hemidiaphragms elevated to roughly the 8th posterior rib); large bilateral breast shadows overlie and partially obscure both lower zones and lung bases.

devices.type: Small metallic density (possible surgical clip or external artifact)
devices.location: Projecting over the left hilum / medial left mid zone

devices.type: Tubing / line, likely external (oxygen or IV tubing lying on patient)
devices.location: Curvilinear tubular density at the inferior image edge projecting over the patient's right upper abdomen / flank

devices.type: L side marker with radiographer initials
devices.location: Upper right corner of image (patient's left shoulder)

abnormalities.finding: Patchy hazy airspace opacity / infiltrate centred on the perihilar region, partially obscuring the left heart border
Hazy opacity extending inferiorly from the left perihilar region into the lower zone (partly overlapped by breast shadow)
Low lung volumes with elevated hemidiaphragms (poor inspiration)
Small metallic density projecting over the left hilum (clip vs external artifact)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，影像右側有L標記，為常規方向；吸氣不足、雙側橫膈上抬，雙側大範圍乳房陰影重疊於下肺野。左側中肺野及肺門周圍可見片狀模糊浸潤影，向下延伸至左下肺野並部分遮蔽左心緣；右肺野相對清晰，未見明顯實變或氣胸。心臟大小正常、縱膈居中，雙側肋膈角大致銳利，骨骼結構未見明顯異常。左肺門處另見一小金屬密度影（可能為夾子或體外異物），影像下緣右上腹處可見管狀影，疑為體外管線；未見胸管或引流管。
